items.raw_excerpt: I could have gone to the Sierra Gorda or visited the caves at Tolantongo. I'm happy I landed on Oaxaca, writes Jared Tucker, who is wrapping up his internship with Mexico News Daily.
items.summary_en: A travel writer chose Oaxaca for his one big Mexico trip. He picked it over the Sierra Gorda and the caves at Tolantongo. He is happy about his choice.

items.raw_excerpt: El alcalde Ali Manouchehri dio a conocer la decisión este jueves, tras haber previamente suspendido el evento para centrarse en la reconstrucción.
items.summary_en: Coquimbo's mayor announced the decision on Thursday. The town will hold a smaller, solidarity-minded version of the Pampilla for Fiestas Patrias. The event was suspended earlier so the town could focus on rebuilding.

items.raw_excerpt: Syama Prasad Mookerjee's contributions will be added to West Bengal school textbooks next year, says Chief Minister Adhikari.

items.raw_excerpt: Ein eigens produzierter Film, ein Dorffest und ein Zwetschgenkuchen-Märit: Am 13. September findet rund um die reformierte Kirche der «Konolfinger Bettag» statt. Ergänzt wird der Anlass durch Musik und Angebote für Kinder.

items.summary_en: Igor Lichnovsky, a new player for Universidad de Chile, talked about Marcelo Diaz's retirement announcement. He said Diaz should be valued as a Chilean player.

items.raw_excerpt: Gen Z kanwariyas navigate tradition, identity, and social expectations during their pilgrimage to Haridwar.
items.summary_en: Young Gen Z pilgrims are walking barefoot to Haridwar for the Kanwar pilgrimage. They are balancing old traditions with their identity and what society expects. The journey tests their faith and sense of belonging.

items.raw_excerpt: Es segunda vez que pasa en un mes este tipo de incidentes en el "Lucio Fariña".

items.summary_en: Taiwan named Xincheng Township in Hualien one of its 30 classic small towns for 2021. The town offers views of Qingshui Cliff and the beautiful Qixingtan beach. Visitors can ride a seaside bike path, explore fishing-village culture, and see the old street with its Noah's Ark-shaped church.

items.raw_excerpt: Haridwar faces a major cleanup after Kanwar Yatra left 7,000 tonnes of waste, prompting awareness initiatives for future pilgrims.
items.summary_en: A big cleanup is underway in Haridwar after the Kanwar Yatra festival. Pilgrims left 7,000 tonnes of waste, including urine-filled bottles at Har Ki Pauri. Local groups are starting awareness programs for future pilgrims.

items.raw_excerpt: A car owner in northern Vietnam has been fined VND474.6 million (US$18,100) after AI traffic cameras logged 96 violations by his vehicle in just over five months, 21 of them speeding offenses in July alone.
items.summary_en: A car owner in northern Vietnam was fined about 18,100 US dollars. AI traffic cameras logged 96 violations by his vehicle in just over five months. Twenty-one of them were speeding offenses in July alone.
items.summary_ko: 베트남 북부의 한 차주가 지난 5개월 남짓 동안 교통 위반을 96번 해 AI 카메라에 적발됐다. 그 가운데 7월 한 달에만 과속 위반이 21건이었다. 당국은 이 차주에게 약 4746만 베트남 동(미화 1만8100달러)의 벌금을 물렸다.
items.title_en: Car owner fined $18,100 after AI cameras catch 96 violations
